home.metaTitle: Matcha Wholesale Supplier — Bulk Matcha & Superfoods at Origin
home.metaDescription: Bulk matcha and superfood powders for manufacturers — single-origin, lab-tested every batch (JAS, EU & USDA Organic), from sample to full container. Superfoods Partners sources direct from origin. Request a quote.
home.heroIntro: Grown by people we know, in places we return to season after season — then tested, documented and moved at the scale you need.
home.heroBadge: A Pure Matcha Partners company · Direct from origin
home.peopleHeading: The source is a relationship, not a transaction.
home.peopleBody: We buy directly from growers we know by name, in regions we return to season after season. Their care for the soil is the first quality check — long before the lab. When we say “trusted at origin,” we mean there is a person standing at that origin, and we have shaken their hand.

peopleItems.d: Long-term contracts and fair pricing that let farms invest in the land.
Shade-grown, low-intervention practices, protected across generations.
A name, a place and a coordinate behind every batch we route.

home.peopleCaption: A GROWER IN THE GARDENS AT HARVEST
home.sourceBody: We buy at the source — across Asia and beyond — then route every batch through our hub in Hong Kong. Follow the flows.
home.traceBody: Pick a product and follow it from origin to your facility. Every batch arrives with a full Verification Record — the same checks we'd want if we were the ones buying. Nothing hidden, nothing to chase down.
home.stepsBody: Tell us what you need; we handle origin, testing and documentation — and keep you in the loop the whole way. You approve before anything scales.

steps.d: Product, grade, volume and market. A short brief is enough to get going.
You taste, test and approve — before anything scales to volume.
A Verification Record and full COA travel with every batch.
FOB, CIF or DDP — routed through the hub, in 2–4 weeks.

home.hkHeading: One hub, so trust isn't scattered.
home.hkBody1: Asia's origins meet the world here. From a single bonded hub we consolidate, test and document every shipment — so you work with one partner who knows your spec, not a dozen brokers who don't.
home.hkBody2: And there are people behind it: a team you can call, in your timezone, who actually pick up. Part of the Pure Matcha Partners family.
home.socialHeading: For teams who can't afford a bad batch.
home.socialBody: Beverage, supplement and foodservice brands come to us when consistency isn't optional — and stay because the documentation is always there when they need it.
home.socialQuote: “They catch the things we'd miss — and when our auditors ask for paperwork, it's already there.”
home.socialQuoteAttr: Head of Procurement · EU beverage brand
home.ctaBody: Tell us what you need and at what scale. We'll source, verify and document it — and route it through Hong Kong to you.
home.ctaNote: Send your spec — lab report & quote within 48 hours

core.heading: Infrastructure, not a middleman.
core.body: Ten commitments define how we operate — from the farm to your facility. This is the model behind the story: why buyers trust us with volume, not just with warmth.

items.d: An integrated sourcing and supply company — we build partnerships at origin, we don't simply trade ingredients.
We invest alongside producers in farms, facilities, quality and long-term capacity.
Sourcing, compliance, quality control, logistics and project management across the chain.
We transparently combine origins for consistent quality, security of supply and scale.
One entity manages sourcing, suppliers, QA, compliance and logistics across Asia.
Every batch tested against the highest international quality and food-safety standards.
Documentation, traceability and compliance systems built for global manufacturers.
Built for high volume — consistent quality, reliable logistics, scalable operations.
Farm to final delivery: sourcing, QA, documentation, logistics — managed by us.
Lasting relationships with growers, processors and customers — not transactional trading.

about.metaTitle: About — the trusted superfood sourcing partner
about.metaDescription: Superfoods Partners is the Hong Kong–based sourcing arm of the Pure Matcha Partners family. We don't aim to be the largest supplier — we aim to be the most trusted.
about.heroBody1: Superfoods Partners is the sourcing engine of the Pure Matcha Partners family. We buy direct from the farms that grow the world's finest superfoods and move large, verified volumes to the biggest manufacturers — routed, when it helps, through our hub in Hong Kong.
about.heroBody2: We don't aspire to be the largest supplier. We aspire to be the one you never have to worry about.

verification.metaTitle: Verification — how every batch is tested & documented
verification.metaDescription: Origin Intelligence™: how Superfoods Partners tests, documents and traces every batch. Lab panels, the Verification Record™, certifications and answers to common sourcing questions.
verification.heading: Warmth you can audit.
verification.intro: The human story earns attention; the paperwork earns the contract. Every batch we ship is tested, documented and traceable — so your QA team, your auditors and your customers all get the same answer.
verification.photoCaption: QUALITY AT SOURCE — CUPPED & GRADED BY HAND

steps.d: Direct relationships with growers and processors, worldwide.
Pesticide residue, heavy metals, microbiology, radiation — independently tested.
A Verification Record™ and full COA accompany every shipment.
Consolidated, bonded and shipped from one trusted hub.

panel: Heavy metals — lead, arsenic, cadmium, mercury
Microbiology — total plate count, yeast & mould, pathogens
verification.recordBody: A single document that travels with each batch: origin and coordinates, batch and COA references, the full test panel, certifications, and the route through Hong Kong. One source of truth — for you, your auditors and your customers.

faq.a: We supply from 25 kg up to full container volume. Sampling is available before you commit to a recurring program.
Yes — every batch ships with a Verification Record™ and a full Certificate of Analysis (COA), covering pesticides, heavy metals, microbiology and more.

faq.q: What are your lead times and Incoterms?
faq.a: Typically 2–4 weeks, consolidated and routed through our Hong Kong hub. We work FOB, CIF or DDP depending on your needs.

faq.q: Can you do private label or custom blends?
faq.a: Yes. Through our Blend Library™ we support private-label and custom formulations for manufacturers and co-packers.
JAS, EU Organic, USDA Organic, HACCP, FSSC 22000 and Kosher, alongside independent lab testing on every batch.
